# kayrock v1.0.0 - Table of Contents

Elixir interface to the Kafka protocol

- [Kayrock](https://kayrock.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

- Exceptions
  - [Kayrock.ErrorCode.InvalidAtomException](https://kayrock.hexdocs.pm/Kayrock.ErrorCode.InvalidAtomException.md): Raised if `Kayrock.ErrorCode.atom_to_code!/1` is called with an atom that
does not correspond to a known Kafka error code.

  - [Kayrock.ErrorCode.InvalidErrorCodeException](https://kayrock.hexdocs.pm/Kayrock.ErrorCode.InvalidErrorCodeException.md): Raised if `Kayrock.ErrorCode.code_to_atom!/1` is called with a code that
does not correspond to a known Kafka error code.

  - [Kayrock.InvalidRequestError](https://kayrock.hexdocs.pm/Kayrock.InvalidRequestError.md): Raised on serialization errors

## Mix Tasks

- [mix gen.kafka_protocol](https://kayrock.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Gen.KafkaProtocol.md): Mix task to generate the .ex files for each of the kafka protocol messages
